mapper.select:
select m.id, m.title, m.content, m.images, m.like_count, m.create_time, u.nickname, u.avatar,
(SELECT COUNT(sml.id) > 0 FROM sys_moment_like sml WHERE sml.moment_id = m.id AND sml.user_id = #{userId}) AS is_like,
(SELECT COUNT(sc.id) FROM sys_comment sc WHERE sc.business_id = m.id AND sc.comment_type = 2) AS comment_num from sys_moment m left join sys_user u on m.user_id = u.id order by m.create_time desc

mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_moment_like WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND moment_id = #{momentId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(id) > 0 FROM sys_moment_like WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND moment_id = #{momentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_moment SET like_count = GREATEST(IFNULL(like_count, 0) + #{delta}, 0) WHERE id = #{momentId}
